findings.highlight: It’s sad, but I guess all I can do is stay here.
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しいが、ここに留まるしかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou is frustrated and humiliated that he has no useful choice but to remain behind.
findings.explanation: Sadness replaces self-directed frustration at his inability to support Saber.

findings.evidenceJa: 肌に張り付くような六十秒
findings.governingReading: Sixty seconds seem to cling to Shirou’s skin as he waits.
findings.explanation: The English preserves elapsed time but removes the oppressive tactile duration of helpless waiting.

findings.evidenceJa: 地上百メートルもの高み
findings.governingReading: The lights disappear toward the rooftop roughly one hundred meters above ground.
findings.explanation: A few hundred multiplies the stated height and materially distorts the building’s scale.

findings.evidenceJa: 矢継ぎ早に、振り子のように繰り返される
findings.governingReading: The light repeats rapidly, swinging back and forth like a pendulum.
findings.explanation: The English omits the pendular pattern that distinguishes repeated traversals from generic flashes.

findings.governingReading: Illya asks why Shirou looks gloomy or downcast.
findings.explanation: Serious loses the visible unhappiness that prompts her question.

findings.highlight: I didn’t come here today to talk either.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はお話をしにきたワケじゃないもの
findings.governingReading: Illya says she did not come to talk today, closing the spoken line before the narration resumes.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the quotation unclosed, obscuring the boundary between her threat and narration.

findings.highlight: Murderous intent seeps in into Illya’s gaze.
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの視線に殺気が灯る
findings.governingReading: Murderous intent kindles in Illya’s gaze.
findings.explanation: Seeps in into is grammatically malformed and weakens the sudden ignition marking her return to the Berserker Master persona.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s vision cuts out; only after time in complete darkness does his consciousness finally snap off.
findings.explanation: Fades changes the first abrupt cutoff into a gradual one and weakens the ordered sensory shutdown.

findings.highlight: the preparation for acceptance of the prime field
findings.governingReading: Sella reports that preparations for the base body or vessel to receive the transfer are complete.
findings.explanation: Prime field is a categorical mistranslation that conceals the physical recipient and makes the transfer procedure unintelligible.
